project_history_same_270_cases.status: new best internal held-out result for this project

why_not_like_for_like: 0.741 was measured by DPD-SAM's authors on THEIR OWN 8:2 split, not these 270 cases
their SAM-Med3D baseline prompt protocol is not disclosed anywhere in the paper
BCGFMamba transcribes that number as 0.731, which does not match DPD-SAM's own table, so even the reference value is unstable
this arm uses 3 accumulated GT corrective clicks, which is an interactive protocol; the reference sits in a table of automatic methods

evidence_boundary: Training and epoch selection used NO test data. The freeze was written before any test NIfTI was opened.
These 270 cases have now been consumed 5 times by this project, so this is an internal held-out number, not clean external validation.
This result must NOT be used to select a next arm, tune hyperparameters, or choose between models. Any further model development must return to the 972/108 clean validation.
No threshold, TTA, morphology, connected-component or postprocessing search was run.

duplicate_run_disclosure.what_happened: The agent session was resumed under a new session directory and the single authorized evaluation was issued twice, 30 seconds apart, against the same frozen configuration.
duplicate_run_disclosure.verified_identical: All 270 cases carry byte-identical DSC at clicks 1, 2 and 3; the summary blocks are equal; the checkpoint SHA and seed are the same. The only differing top-level fields are created_at_utc and elapsed_seconds.
duplicate_run_disclosure.scientific_impact: None. The evaluation is deterministic given the frozen checkpoint, the case-seeded PCG64 click sampling and seed 20260723, so the repeat produced the same numbers rather than a second draw. No selection among runs was possible or performed.
duplicate_run_disclosure.process_impact: The declared runs_allowed=1 was nonetheless violated in the literal sense that the sealed test was opened twice. Disclosed here rather than silently reporting a single run.
duplicate_run_disclosure.remediation: The 13:21:46 report is treated as canonical; the duplicate is retained unmodified as evidence rather than deleted.
